slides.headline:
Still logging in
with just a *password*?
slides.sub: The UK's National Cyber Security Centre wants that to change. Its annual review came out last week.

slides.statement: reports of cyber attacks reached the NCSC in a year.
slides.detail: 337 needed its support. 80 were nationally significant.
slides.source: NCSC Annual Review 2026. UK, 1 Sep 2025 to 31 Aug 2026.

slides.text: The majority of cyber attacks against individuals begin with the theft, compromise or abuse of *passwords*.
